response_payload.rationale_summary: The first exact selector attempt failed with a typed selector requiring refinement. I revised the selector and continued with the registered near-match branches. I retrieved all four US_TREASURY_5Y_CMT treasury_yield_5y observations for the dates 1972-03-07 through 1972-03-10, computed the growth rate for each adjacent interval, and calculated the mean growth of the first two intervals. I then compared the growth of the 1972-03-09 to 1972-03-10 interval against that mean. The growth of the later interval exceeded the mean, with a difference of 0.692578664111326065076810887, and the higher reference was the growth operation for the 1972-03-09 to 1972-03-10 interval. The evidence was cross-checked and verified.
